# NextZen Academy

> NextZen Academy is a premier early learning, infant daycare, and preschool academy located in Bothell / Woodinville, WA.

## Overview
NextZen Academy provides comprehensive, nurturing early childhood education from infant care through Pre-K. Our programs combine purposeful daily routines, sensory discovery, play-based exploration, and foundational literacy and math to prepare every child for kindergarten and beyond.

## Campus Location & Contact
- **Address:** 21304 State Route 9 SE, Woodinville, WA 98072
- **Phone:** +1 (425) 325-0431
- **Email:** info@nextzenacademy.com
- **Website:** https://www.nextzenacademy.com
- **Hours of Operation:** Monday – Friday, 7:00 AM – 5:00 PM

## Core Programs & Classrooms
1. **Little Blossoms (Infant Care)**
   - **Ages:** 6 weeks to 12 months
   - **Ratio:** 1 caregiver : 3 infants
   - **Focus:** Sensory development, tummy time, language & bonding, individualized feed-sleep routines in a safe and loving space.

2. **Tiny Explorers (Toddlers)**
   - **Ages:** 13 to 24 months
   - **Ratio:** 1 caregiver : 4 toddlers
   - **Focus:** Guided gross and fine motor movement, daily story time, early vocabulary building, and social interaction.

3. **Curious Cubs (Early Preschool)**
   - **Ages:** 2-Year-Olds
   - **Ratio:** 1 teacher : 5 children
   - **Focus:** Cognitive puzzles, shape & color sorting, group circle time routines, self-care habits, and creative arts.

4. **Little Discoverers (Preschool)**
   - **Ages:** 3 to 4-Year-Olds
   - **Ratio:** 1 teacher : 8 children
   - **Focus:** Pre-reading & phonics, STEAM foundations, creative expression, pencil grip, and classroom behavior skills.

5. **Pre-K (Kindergarten Readiness)**
   - **Ages:** 4 to 5-Year-Olds
   - **Ratio:** 1 teacher : 8 children
   - **Focus:** Early reading & writing, number sense up to 20, visual block coding challenges, peer collaboration, and self-regulation.

## Admissions & Campus Tours
- Families are encouraged to schedule a personalized 30-minute campus tour to visit our classrooms and meet teachers.
- Tour bookings can be scheduled directly online at https://www.nextzenacademy.com/schedule-tour.
